verdict.rationale: Rive serves its docs pages as Markdown (introduction.md returns HTTP 200) with a header directing agents to a complete documentation index at https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt, and a separate probe confirms that docs llms.txt exists and was read (it lists an OpenAPI document). The root https://rive.app/llms.txt returns 404, so an agent must be pointed at the /docs/ path. Missing for 10: a root-level llms.txt, direct confirmation of the /docs/llms.txt contents and coverage, evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt
the docs llms.txt lists an OpenAPI document
